questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question probes realism around feature flags and canary rollouts, emphasizing runtime toggling, deterministic segmentation, and end-to-end integrity across UI and backend boundaries. It also assesses how to design deterministic tests in a dynamic release scenario.

## Key Concepts

- Feature flags and canary rollout semantics
- Runtime toggling without full page reload
- Deterministic user seeding and segmentation
- E2E coverage across desktop/mobile
- Data isolation for reusable test seeds

## Code Example

```javascript
// Playwright pseudo-snippet: intercept canary flag and route UI
const flagApi = '/flags/newCheckout'
await page.route(flagApi, route => {
  route.fulfill({ status: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ enabled: true, canaryPercent: 10 }) })
})
// visit checkout and assert NEW UI present for canary users
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you scale this to multiple canary percentages (e.g., 10%, 50%, 90%)?
- How do you guard against flakiness when the canary decision is client-side vs server-side?

questions.explanation:
## Selector Reliability
getByRole() is more maintainable as it focuses on semantic meaning rather than visual presentation. It survives UI redesigns and internationalization changes.

## Accessibility Benefits
getByRole() ensures your app is screen-reader compatible by testing the same attributes assistive technologies use.

## When to Use Each
- **getByRole()**: Buttons, links, form controls, navigation
- **getByText()**: Error messages, static labels, content validation

## Common Pitfalls
getByText() can match multiple elements or fail with dynamic content. getByRole() requires proper ARIA implementation.

## Performance Considerations
getByRole() is generally faster as it leverages browser accessibility tree, while getByText() requires DOM traversal and text matching.

```javascript
// Good: Semantic interaction
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click();

// Good: Content validation
expect(page.getByText('Success!')).toBeVisible();

// Bad: Brittle text selection
await page.getByText('Click here').click(); // Fails if text changes
```
